record.summary: The first-match-wins rule table that maps a relative path (plus action, entry kind, and delta) to a semantic kind and a human label: transcripts, subagent transcripts, memory, file-history buckets, session registry, paste cache, shell snapshots, state-file rewrites, config edits, and the rest of the ~/.claude taxonomy. Unclassified is a first-class outcome with a loud label, never an error.
record.title: Semantic classification of observed events
